key_concepts: Energy is the capacity to do work
Kinetic energy is energy in motion
Potential energy is stored energy due to position
Kinetic energy depends on mass and velocity
Potential energy depends on mass, height, and gravity
PE = mgh or weight x height
Joules and newton-meters are units of energy
Gravitational acceleration near Earth is 9.8 m/s^2
As an object falls, potential energy decreases and kinetic energy increases

Energy can convert between potential and kinetic forms
